title: Add a Cookies & Privacy policy customization section to GeoNode Themes
body:
Allow GeoNoders to be able to turn on and customize the "Cookies & Privacy" warnings as required by the current laws on privacy.

In the "custom theme" section, extend the model in order to include the cookies & privacy settings

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1278021/57156885-6cae2f00-6ddf-11e9-8c33-fc67915b3de5.png)
...
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1278021/57156893-759f0080-6ddf-11e9-8280-ef187d1e10bf.png)

Once enabled, the outcome will be something like this:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1278021/57156916-8cddee00-6ddf-11e9-9f20-3da4b0e118b3.png)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1278021/57156928-96675600-6ddf-11e9-9f6c-0e97c9bdfeae.png)
